angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,036,593 km at 403.05 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.4811 +/- 0.0255 mas (same row, RUWE 1.07): 403.05 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.49 +/- 0.19 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,036,593 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 2.28 +/- 0.99 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6550 +/- 100 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-17.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.450, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-17 (pscomppars): spectral type F4, from Triaud et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...524A..25T/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-17 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.25 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-17 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.61272, from Panek et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..51P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-17 (pscomppars): age 2.65 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-17 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 9.92 km/s, from Triaud et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...524A..25T/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
